This is a direct instruction that tells authors exactly what to do (list the supernet's training time) and how to apply it (include it for comparison), so authors can directly identify the modification they should make. The phrase "for comparison" gives concrete guidance on how the added information should be used. Therefore, the comment contains an explicit action with concrete implementation details, meeting the highest level of the rubric.
